decision_reason: Four exact Q20 T1 Illumina reads establish the compound haplotype; its translation passes the evidence gate and is ranked as an explicit assembled antigen.
dna_only: The historical isolated 22-bp deletion predicts a different protein. Full evidence instead supports adjacent substitutions plus a 28-nt deletion on one haplotype.
interpretation: The compound protein encodes ...DRAH..., not the listed-only ...DSTQ... or deletion-only ...DLAH... alternatives. The website now publishes the same compound protein context.
limitation: This is a transcript-aware reference-plus-compound-edit translation, not a whole-RNA Isovar protein reconstruction; that distinction is retained in the source metadata.
